title: Theme recovery supersedes every inactive rule within the requested edits or refuses without writing
steps: Change the theme after two rendered-word edits; request one edit, then request all edits.
Try wrong anchors/kinds, duplicate or missing rule lists and an ordinary revision conflict.
expect: Partial, malformed or unproven coverage returns STORE_CHANGED with zero writes.
Complete coverage uses a fresh raw proof and writes only requested destinations, reporting current-theme recovery.
Ordinary conflicts do not trigger raw fallback or claim READ_FAILED.
evidence: After Restaurant1.0.2 update, Contact old rules became inactive and whole-output inspection was misreported as READ_FAILED.
fence: Recovery requires every existing raw-rule identity to be superseded after DOM, count and region checks; native proof/revision/digest/theme/dry-render remain authoritative.

tests: theme recovery requires every old raw rule to be superseded: full
theme recovery requires every old raw rule to be superseded: partial
an ordinary inspect conflict does not trigger raw recovery or claim a failed read
